label: Narrative experience
tagline: Immersive walk-into-this-place pieces — dramaturgy, presence, felt-state
description: Crafts pieces where the user walks into a place and leaves changed: a museum microsite that lives, an exhibition extension that breathes, a memorial that holds, a character portrait at depth, an editorial scrollytelling piece that earns its long-form. Inherits simulation-orchestrator's discipline (4 paradigms — 2d-illustrative / 3d-environment / iconographic-anim / hybrid — pipeline shape, scene-builder fanout, lens trio, multi-draft at the moments of creative divergence, cross-drawer coherence review). What changes is purpose: where simulation gives the user UNDERSTANDING of a system, narrative-experience gives the user PRESENCE inside a place. Three structural substitutions, each in service of felt-experience: spine (the dramaturgy — authored moments, some anchored to time/scroll, some waiting in space to be found) replaces loop; reveals (the act of attention — gentle progressive discovery, plus body-carrying navigation when the scene is walkable) replaces controls; ambient (the soundscape — the room listening back) is a new first-class channel. Walkable 3D lives inside the 3d-environment paradigm; freedom of movement is the breathing room WITHIN the script, not absence of authorship. Collaborates with visual-orchestrator for raster imagery — painterly plates, character portraits, artifact close-ups, texture maps — so every asset inherits the brief's styleCue and the piece reads as one. Concept-lens scores against felt-state successFeel ('the room holds them', 'they leave quieter'), never informational outcomes. Two cross-boundary contracts the orchestrator enforces beyond the per-drawer lens trios: §1.2 iframe ↔ host pointer + scroll contract (touch-action policy, overlay pointer-events budget, guaranteed scroll-past affordance, wheel forwarding, pointer-capture cleanup) and §5.6 Phase F layered-interaction QA + fix pass the chat caller runs after Step-8 QA — catches violations no per-component lens can see because they live at the iframe ↔ host boundary no drawer owns (canonical case: museuuum 'glitchy at entrance and i cant scroll' thread).

triggers.title: build a site with this piece
triggers.rule: User wants the experience embedded in a larger app/site (rare for narrative — most are whole-page). Top-level Claude scaffolds the shell (with nx-placeholder slot), then dispatches narrative-experience-orchestrator per slot, drives the build, embeds per the playbook.
